independence: Separate new project; do not alter frozen TTF-Q, Phase-4, or relational v0.3; never reopen any previously closed response.
biological_question: Does 21ka-to-0BP climatic displacement add out-of-species prediction of geographic contrasts in within-species genetic heterozygosity, after modern climate and geography?
response: Within-study and within-species differences in expected heterozygosity (He); not mitochondrial Fst or the original TTF genetic transfer score

climate.focal: Euclidean norm of four signed changes each scaled by pooled TRAINING-population SD of corresponding 0BP value
climate.baseline: Same-product four 0BP bioclim variables, geographic latitude/longitude, study-specific genotyping/sample controls

before_opening.taxon_join: exact binomial or deterministic synonym-mapping table frozen before response
before_opening.outcome_mask_allowed: He present/missing only; do not inspect numerical He

inference.split: fixed SHA256 species hash namespace ttf-fresh-quaternary-gendivrange-v01; train and evaluation have disjoint species
inference.score: Equal study-species weight, paired held-out within-study contrast MSE: baseline versus one predeclared history term
inference.spatial_sampling: do not treat population pairs as independent

caveats: GenDivRange uses mostly microsatellite heterozygosity, not TTF COI differentiation
Historic fields are sampled at modern genetic population sites, not inferred refugia
Predictor-nonredundancy alone is not biological outcome relevance
Do not infer general causation from any association
Only independent genetic response counts as an empirical ecological endpoint
